thread:
Ana: Quick thread to finalize voice + naming rules for the upcoming style pass. We need a short decision set so PRs can be merged without bikeshedding.

Priya: Agree. Can we keep decisions minimal & prescriptive? Suggestion: 1) Use friendly-professional tone (contractions OK), 2) Use second-person "you" for instructions, 3) Use present-tense for procedures.

Joel: +1 on contractions. Also propose a naming hierarchy for product surfaces in docs: use product canonical names first (Redwood API, Redwood Dedicated, Redwood Private), then short form in parentheses on first mention. Example: "Redwood Dedicated (Dedicated)".

Ana: Good. We should also pick a canonical term for models vs checkpoints. Proposal: use "model" in user-facing docs. Use "checkpoint" only in deep-dive/engineering articles where it's technically accurate.

Ken: For SDK param names in examples, maintain literal API names for code snippets, but canonicalize human copy. So code block uses `model` if that's the API, but narrative can say "model checkpoint" where helpful.

Priya: On glossary entries: add short aliases to each term so search finds them (e.g., "model" aliases: "checkpoint", "artifact"). That should reduce confusion.

Joel: Microcopy rule: prefer nouns over verbs for section headings (e.g., "Deployment" not "Deploying"). Short titles help nav.

Ana: Accessibility note: avoid color metaphors and don't write "click the green button". Use descriptive controls like "Click **Create deployment**". Include in style doc.

Ken: Regarding capitalization: use sentence case for headers and UI labels; use Title Case only for product names.

Priya: For glossary wording, keep definitions one to two sentences, then a short "When to use" bullet line. Example: "model: a trained parameterized LLM. When to use: user-facing examples and API parameters."

Ana: Action items: Priya to update style guide doc with these bullets; Joel to open PR template that references the style guide; Ken to run a grep for term variants and create a `DOCS-4902` ticket for bulk fixes.

Priya: I'll update style-guide.md and add a tiny checklist at the top of PRs: "Check: tone, product names, model vs checkpoint, header case, accessibility phrasing."

Joel: I'll add the checklist to .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and include links to the relevant style-guide sections.

Ken: I'll generate a CSV of hits for `checkpoint|modelName|artifact|model-name` and attach to DOCS-4902. Will tag owners for pages with >5 hits.

docs-bot: Reminder: add `#style` and `#glossary` labels to the style guide PRs. Also add the new glossary terms as evergreen items in the docs backlog.

Ana: Thanks. Let's reconvene after the PRs land to triage the big bulk ticket. If anyone wants to argue a specific naming case, please bring a short rationale to the review rather than inline debate. Keeps reviews fast. :pray:
